title: LedgerAggregatesRepository — single CASE-aggregated GROUP BY
scope: New repository file. Single class LedgerAggregatesRepository(BaseRepository[StockLedgerModel]) with one method: sum_deltas_by_source_type(month_start, as_of_date) → list[Row]. Single SELECT with CASE-conditional SUMs over tbl_stock_ledger, GROUP BY (design_id, grade_id), WHERE txn_date BETWEEN month_start AND as_of_date. Returns rows with columns: design_id, grade_id, inward_sum, outward_sum, adjust_sum.

success_criteria.manual: Construct repo with a session, call sum_deltas_by_source_type(date(2026,6,1), date(2026,6,30)) on seeded ledger data — verify exactly one row per (design, grade) with correct SUMs and date filtering.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Class exports LedgerAggregatesRepository. Single SQL statement (one round-trip). outward_sum is positive (SUM of -delta on source_type='sale' must be inverted so the dashboard column reads as outgoing quantity, NOT negative). Uses ix_stock_ledger_dgt (Index Range Scan visible via EXPLAIN — verified manually if PG available).

checkout_prompt: LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type implemented. Single GROUP BY + CASE-aggregated SUMs. Ready for DashboardService composition in T-061.
